profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Most people call me Ozzy.  I started working as an Associate Software Engineer for a BioPharma company, helping get many if their internal reporting  systems from an idea to changing integral day to day operations at the company.  Eventually, I worked my way up to lead software engineer and met many great people and learned many lessons along the way. 

I then moved onto working as a full stack software engineer for Mulberry Technology, helping to disrupt the insurance market and give more power to the consumer!
My daily work revolved around React, HTML, CSS, TypeScript, Javascript, and Python.  I also have knowledge of many in-demand technologies including Django, Flask, Bootstrap, Tailwind, and Vue.js.

Now, my career has taken me to working as a Senior Software Engineer at New Balance!  Here I work to onboard, guide, and mentor new Software Engineers.  All the while, I am working to build and enhance the Product Description Page on our dozens of sites all around the world, when you click a shoe and see the page to pick a size, that's me!
The technologies I work with are the Salesforce ecosystem (specifically SFCC), JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, and C#!
I am an active participant in our communities of practice for Salesforce, Agile, Front End, Back End, and AI!
I am also an active Epic Owner, regularly helping to scope and see high priority stories into successful completion.

I believe a good engineer is a Swiss army knife, and that's why I always try to pick up new tools and talents.  I'm always on the lookout for new ways to use my skills!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working as a member of the main salesforce e-commerce team that manages the main PDPs on all global New Balance sites.  This is done using HTML, CSS, Sass, and JavaScript for the frontend and C# with Azure services on the backend.
Guiding and mentoring new software engineers.
Scoping out, overseeing, and delivering on Epics in an agile framework

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Working as a member of the main salesforce e-commerce team that manages the main PDPs on all global New Balance sites.  This is done using HTML, CSS, Sass, and JavaScript for the frontend and C# with Azure services on the backend.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Primarily working as a full-stack engineer on a chrome store extension and on 3rd party Shopify and BigCommerce integrations.  Working in tandem with team leads and stakeholders to scope out projects and guide the team toward success on a sprint-by-sprint basis.  Also responsible for working on a  rotating support shift for partner integrations and internal customer issues.  Primary work includes using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind for the frontend and Flask, Python, and Postgres for the backend.
